content.short: Streamr provides many-to-many data pipelines, network analytics, and instant messaging.
content.description: Streamr offers a serverless data infrastructure that is secure, fast, scalable, and decentralized. Web3 projects commonly rely on Streamr as middleware to connect data streams across systems, enabling real-time data flows without managing servers. It is used in oracles, IoT pipelines, messaging apps, and a range of other event-driven applications, helping developers build responsive, data-driven experiences across multiple networks and environments.
